verdict.rationale: Cal.com's API can query available slots across multiple attendees via the 'usernames only' dynamic event type mode (docs-38) and supports round-robin host selection with priority/weight logic (docs-25/41), and its agents.md explicitly frames 'Check availability' as an AI-agent capability (docs-12/17/31). However, there is no evidence of an AI actively comparing/optimizing across all attendees' calendars beyond returning open slots, nor any 'continuous optimization' or re-optimization loop once a meeting is booked. missing for 10: evidence of an actual optimization algorithm beyond first-available-slot matching, evidence of continuous/automatic re-optimization after scheduling, and any hands-on demonstration of an AI agent doing this end-to-end.
